title: graphrt plugin manifest (protocol_version 1)
description: A graphrt-plugin.json / graphrt-plugin.yaml manifest. Specified in docs/plugin-manifest.md. Rules that depend on several fields (node kinds prefixed with `<name>.`, unique kinds and tool names, the pinned entrypoint, https for credentials, `bearer_token_env` listed in `permissions.env`) are checked by graphrt when the manifest is loaded, not by this schema.

name.description: Plugin id: 1-64 lowercase ASCII letters, digits, `-` or `_`. Node kinds start with `<name>.` and tools are offered under provider `<name>`.

version.description: Plugin version. Free-form for the host; semver is required to publish to the graphrt-plugins catalog.

description.description: One-line summary shown by `graphrt plugin list` and `info`.

protocol_version.description: Protocol (and manifest format) version the plugin speaks. This host speaks exactly 1.

runtime.description: How the plugin runs: a child process (JSON-RPC over stdio), an HTTP service (JSON-RPC over POST) or a WebAssembly module.

command.description: runtime process: program to run. A relative path with a separator (`./bin/plugin`) is resolved against the plugin directory; a bare name (`python3`) is looked up in PATH.

env.description: runtime process: fixed environment variables for the process.

inherit_env.description: runtime process: pass the whole host environment instead of a clean one.

cwd.description: runtime process: working directory, relative to the plugin directory and without `..` segments. Default: the plugin directory.

bearer_token_env.description: runtime http: host environment variable holding a bearer token. Must be listed in `permissions.env`; needs a trusted plugin and an https (or loopback) `url`.

module.description: runtime wasm: module path, relative to the plugin directory.

checksums.description: Relative path -> sha256 hex of the file, verified at install and before every start. When non-empty it must pin the entrypoint (a `command` inside the plugin directory, or the wasm `module`).

tools.description: Tools for `tool` and `agent` nodes, under provider `<name>`.

allow_unprefixed_kinds.description: Also allow plain node kinds without `.` (e.g. `slugify`). Another plugin's `<other>.` namespace is never allowed.

relative_path.description: A path inside the plugin directory: not blank, not absolute, no `..` segment.

permissions.description: What the plugin asks for. Requests only: the operator grants them.

network.description: Informational: the plugin makes network calls.

env.description: Host environment variables passed to the process (besides PATH, HOME, LANG, TMPDIR and their Windows equivalents).

secrets.description: Receive plaintext secrets. Granted only to trusted plugins (`--trust-plugin`); others get masked values.

max_message_bytes.description: Largest protocol message, sent to the plugin in `initialize`.

node.description: A node descriptor, as in the node catalog (`graphrt nodes --json`).

kind.description: Node `type` in workflows: `<name>.<something>` (or a plain name without `.` with `allow_unprefixed_kinds`). No whitespace.

config_schema.description: JSON Schema of the node's config (the node fields other than id, type, title, parent and policy).

source.description: Ignored: the host sets it to `plugin:<name>`.

handles.description: How the node picks outgoing edges. Default `{"kind": "single"}`.

tool.description: A tool. Unknown keys are ignored.

name.description: Not blank; unique within the plugin.

parameters.description: JSON Schema of the arguments object.
